pattern.why_premium: Two agents visibly progress in lockstep with the narration 'agents can even...', proving parallel background work through real UI state changes instead of decorative motion.

build_hint.gsap: Per pane in an overflow:hidden container: gsap.to('.pane .stack', {y: '-=90', duration: 0.05, ease: 'steps(2)'}); gsap.fromTo('.pane .step:last-child', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.03, ease: 'none'}, '<'); start the second pane ~3 frames after the first.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [start, start + 1], [0, -shift], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) per pane with staggered start frames; appended rows use opacity = frame >= start ? 1 : 0. No spring.
